note: The DIVERGENCE WITNESSES: the witness set of the sealed line-reading revision 24240b2e, carried into this tree so the documents that once told two readers apart survive the reference export they came from. Extracted from that revision's tests/format/cutover-allowlist.json (its families' witnesses and its named documents) and its tests/format/list-shape-allowlist.ts. A witness names the FAMILY it witnesses and the SCOPE the two readers differed in - bytes, readings, or both. A corpus witness carries no source: its id resolves through vendor/asciidoctor-corpus, and re-committing those bytes would be a second copy that can disagree with the first. See tests/lib/divergence-witnesses.ts for the loader and docs/harnesses.md for the workflow.
